project_adaptation: Use supplied disease/molecule/class/area labels plus Phase 1.6 contextual slots.
why_used: Preserves clinically meaningful query structure instead of treating the query as undifferentiated text.
boundary: No new neural NER is trained.

project_adaptation: Separate exact entities, hierarchy, context, intent prior, and conflicts.
why_used: Not every extracted field should have equal semantic meaning or become a hard filter.

project_adaptation: Normalize names; use ICD parent and ATC molecule-to-class relations.
why_used: Recovers clinically related content when exact surface forms or molecule identity differ.
boundary: No external synonym ontology; hierarchy is limited to supplied codes.

project_adaptation: Compute exact overlap, coverage, hierarchy, context match, and conflict features for every pair.
why_used: Makes NER operational as ranking evidence rather than descriptive metadata.
boundary: Missing title evidence is unknown, not a negative.

project_adaptation: Expose an equal-weight structured score for later BM25/hybrid reranking.
why_used: Provides a CPU-friendly signal that can be ablated in later retrieval experiments.
boundary: Phase 7.5 does not tune weights or evaluate a ranker.

project_adaptation: Audit extraction separately and retain feature groups for later ablation.
why_used: Distinguishes extraction quality from downstream retrieval contribution.
boundary: Existing slot QA is limited without independent clinician gold labels.
